sources.title: Independent minimal-edit and denominator derivation
sources.details: 今天去臺北 has five codepoints 今/天/去/臺/北. Its unequal prediction 今天去台北 needs at least one edit; substituting 台→臺 suffices, hence minimum=1 and CER=1/5=0.2. 今天去臺 omits 北; prediction→reference repair inserts 北 once, still 1/5. Each of these Han characters encodes as three UTF-8 bytes, but bytes do not determine this metric. Empty-reference denominator is zero. e+combining acute demonstrates why codepoints are not generally grapheme clusters. Full derivation and conditions are in analysis.md.
